title: Implement TransactionService with idempotent transaction creation
acceptance_criteria: CreateTransaction checks client_uuid first; if exists, returns existing transaction (no double insert)
Computes subtotal, discount, tax, and total from items
Decrements stock via StockService for each item
Records stock_movements with reference_type 'transaction' and reference_id
Records transaction_payments with payment_method_id, amount, change_amount
Stores product_name_snapshot and price_snapshot in transaction_items
Wraps transaction + stock + payments in a DB transaction (all-or-nothing)
completion_summary: TransactionService idempotent (FirstOrFail), totals, stock+ledger, payments, invoice, snapshots; 5 smoke tests pass; First() swallows not-found so FirstOrFail used
